reduction_guard.reason: The bind is the declared divisibility-verdict consumer and divisibility_verdict_capability_is_unbounded is its in-boundary branch; reduction must keep the task-declared verdict-consumer shape. Every parameter change is rechecked for grammar membership and separation.

out_of_envelope_declaration.proof_method: within_grammar_witness of any witness binding these continuations against l1-v0/v1/v2 returns false with reason BIND_CONTINUATION: every input atom of this grammar lies within the old declared index bound (delay_index_max 2), every race partner within race_partner_index_max 2 and every deadline horizon within {0,1,2}, so the new continuation map is the only failing dimension

declared_bounds_note: Complete enumeration of the finite constructor product: atoms = 1 + 2*(delay_index_max+1) = 7; contexts = non-empty well-typed op sequences up to context_depth_max with a deadline only as the final op; denominator is finite and closed. Bounds are deliberately aligned with the existing L1 index horizons (delay_index_max 2, partner 2, horizons {0,1,2}) so that an out-of-envelope witness fails the old grammars on exactly one dimension (BIND_CONTINUATION). DIVISIBILITY shape note: the three verdict continuations express the premise triple's shared omission shape (divisibility treated as an unbounded capability rather than a condition, so that 'not divisible under condition c' has no object in the system) in three genuinely distinct map shapes: divergence on the true branch (capability_is_unbounded: exercising infinite subdivisibility never completes in observation while the conditional limit is only admitted after the full capability spectrum is traversed), divergence on the false branch (no_object_for_condition: the capability verdict is always reachable but the conditional limit has no object), and same-delay/opposite-value at the resolution frontier (same_frontier_opposite: the theory renders opposite verdicts at one shared resolution limit where the reality task has a single answer). Structural consequence derived from the engine semantics, not assumed: because bind adds its own round on top of the continuation index, the two unbounded-capability continuations (inner index 2 or omega on both branches) cannot be separated by a deadline inside horizons {0,1,2} after a bind; only the frontier continuation (inner index 1) admits a bind-then-deadline separation. The pair members of every separating witness are delay-equivalent (the theory's identity criterion judges them the same), and separation must come from a race or deadline, never from the continuation alone, because bind always preserves delay equivalence.
